hypothesis: An incremental concentration-acceleration tilt adds risk-adjusted return beyond existing SOTA momentum and volume signals.
expected_failure_modes: Secondary-market activity is not net capital inflow; selling can increase volume.
Second differences amplify noise; smoothing and thresholding can introduce delay.
Hurst is a persistence diagnostic, not acceleration; short samples can mislead.
Existing SOTA already uses price/volume; new signal may be redundant.
A literal exit gate can mainly reduce market exposure and miss trends.
Historical adjusted prices, FX lineage and universe membership are not point-in-time certified.
decision_rule: Retain for further observation only if the predeclared primary improves full and post-2023 Sharpe, has positive excess compounded return in both periods, is not driven solely by the post-April-2026 extension, survives equal cost/delay stresses, and its adjacent thresholds/lags support the direction. Promotion additionally requires untouched prospective and certified-data evidence.

statistical_audit.multiple_testing: Report every trial; simultaneous max-t adjusted one-sided bootstrap p-values over all 11 challengers. Historical baseline selection is not corrected by this within-study adjustment.

data_policy: Read-only ClickHouse extraction. Exclude documented non-trading calendar dates, reject missing/invalid true sessions, carry prior FX at most seven calendar days with explicit lineage. No current holdings or fabricated net flows. All runs research-only.
execution: Frozen identical data; monthly prior-close decisions, next-session opening fills, 5bps fees base; adjusted CNH whole units, instant settlement, no leverage. Shared SOTA and primary recomputed inside LEAN; other variants replay frozen targets through native LEAN fills.
